claims.statement: OverlayKit/companion-module-overlaykit-server was created as an empty public repository with no prior commits, code, workflows, releases, packages, or rulesets.
claims.evidence: GitHub repository creation and empty local git initialization on 2026-07-23

claims.statement: The parent OverlayKit project already accepts deterministic governance, Apache-2.0 licensing, Rodrigo Vicente attribution, public protocol authority, signed device evidence, and a separate Companion adapter repository.
claims.evidence: OverlayKit ADR-0001, ADR-0018, ADR-0019, ADR-0020, ADR-0031, ADR-0032, ADR-0033, ADR-0034, and CHG-0040

claims.statement: Bootstrapping this repository with its own deterministic plan, manifest, specification, mechanisms, CI evidence, legal provenance, and signed history makes later adapter claims attributable without importing the parent repository's mutable context.
The project owner directly accepts the initial constitution, specification, and bootstrap sequence before remote enforcement exists.
Whether repeated cross-repository use will later justify publishing the private governance host as a reusable package.

successCriteria.statement: The repository begins with a signed commit containing executable governance and legal provenance before adapter product code.
successCriteria.verification: Git history, GitHub commit verification, and absence of src and Companion manifest files in the bootstrap commit.

successCriteria.statement: The same semantic inputs compile deterministically to the stored planHash and manifestHash.

successCriteria.statement: The bootstrap validates immutable records, producer bindings, stale evidence, and dishonest enforcement claims.

GitHub Actions validates governance, quality, and builds and attests the main-branch GovernanceRun before a main ruleset is activated.
successCriteria.verification: First main push workflow, attestation, and external GitHub observation.

definitionOfDone.statement: Governance lint, type-check, tests, compilation, and verification pass.
Licensing tests and repository builds pass.
definitionOfDone.evidence: npm run check && npm run build

definitionOfDone.statement: plan.json and manifest.json match deterministic compilation.
The bootstrap commit is signed, pushed to main, observed, and attested before the configured ruleset is activated.
